claim.final_text:
I filled in the new contact form and clicked Add, but I can't confirm the contact was saved. The browser went blank right after the click and stayed blank.

I waited several minutes and tried going back, going to the home page, typing the contacts list address and reloading. Nothing changed, so I couldn't open the contact list or the new contact's page to check.

The form held exactly these values: last name Petrov, first name Anton, job position Storekeeper, business phone 555-0196, email a.petrov@example.invalid. No third party was selected and every other field was left at its default. Before submitting, the contact list showed three contacts, none of them Anton Petrov. I did not resubmit the form, to avoid creating a duplicate.

RESULT: NOT DONE The browser went blank after clicking Add, so I could not confirm the contact was saved.
